name: Selkies Workspace
description:
Here is a 5-line summary of the conversation:

1. A Dockerfile was being built based on the `selkies-gstreamer` base image for a workspace called `codx-junior-workspace-silkies`.
2. The Dockerfile included a `wget` command that was failing due to an invalid or incomplete URL.
3. The goal was to install a `systemctl` replacement script to enable service management inside a Docker container.
4. The fix involved replacing the broken URL with the correct raw GitHub URL pointing to `systemctl3.py` from the `gdraheim/docker-systemctl-replacement` repository.
5. The corrected Dockerfile also sets up a `codx-junior` user with configurable `USER_ID` and `GROUP_ID` build arguments, sudo privileges, and uses the systemctl replacement as the container entrypoint.

We are creating a Selkies Ubuntu workspace.


```Dockerfil
FROM ghcr.io/selkies-project/selkies-gstreamer/gst-py-example:latest-ubuntu22.04


USER root


# 1. Install Python (Mandatory for the systemctl replacement)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3 \
    wget \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*


# 2. Overwrite /usr/bin/systemctl with the replacement script
RUN wget https://githubusercontent.com -O /usr/bin/systemctl \
    && chmod +x /usr/bin/systemctl


# Now you can safely install tools that require systemctl
# RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y some-service-tool


ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/systemctl", "init"]
```

Docker image must use these settings for creating the codx-junior user:


USER_ID=1001
GROUP_ID=1001

Looking at the Dockerfile, I need to add proper user creation with the specified `USER_ID=1001` and `GROUP_ID=1001`.

```dockerfile codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-silkies/Dockerfile
FROM ghcr.io/selkies-project/selkies-gstreamer/gst-py-example:latest-ubuntu22.04

USER root

# 1. Install Python (Mandatory for the systemctl replacement)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    python3 \
    wget \
    sudo \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# 2. Create codx-junior group and user with specified IDs
RUN groupadd --gid 1001 codx-junior || true \
    && useradd --uid 1001 --gid 1001 --create-home --shell /bin/bash codx-junior \
    && echo "codx-junior ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers \
    && mkdir -p /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior \
    && chown -R 1001:1001 /home/codx-junior-projects

# 3. Overwrite /usr/bin/systemctl with the replacement script
RUN wget https://githubusercontent.com -O /usr/bin/systemctl \
    && chmod +x /usr/bin/systemctl

# Now you can safely install tools that require systemctl
# RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y some-service-tool

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/systemctl", "init"]
```

Key changes made:

1. **Added `sudo`** package installation — required to allow `codx-junior` user to run privileged commands.
2. **Created group** `codx-junior` with `GID=1001` using `groupadd`.
3. **Created user** `codx-junior` with `UID=1001`, `GID=1001`, home directory and bash shell using `useradd`.
4. **Granted passwordless sudo** access to the `codx-junior` user.
5. **Created project directory** `/home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior` and set proper ownership to `1001:1001`.
USER_ID and GROUP_ID must be ARGS passed in the build read from the workspace env

```dockerfile codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-silkies/Dockerfile

ARG GROUP_ID=1001

    python3 \
    wget \
    sudo \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

    && echo "codx-junior ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers \
    && mkdir -p /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior \
    && chown -R ${USER_ID}:${GROUP_ID} /home/codx-junior-projects

# 3. Overwrite /usr/bin/systemctl with the replacement script
RUN wget https://githubusercontent.com -O /usr/bin/systemctl \
    && chmod +x /usr/bin/systemctl

# Now you can safely install tools that require systemctl
# RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y some-service-tool

ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/bin/systemctl", "init"]
```

The `wget` is failing because the URL is invalid/incomplete. The correct URL for the systemctl replacement script from the `gdraheim/docker-systemctl-replacement` project should be used.

```dockerfile codx-junior-installer/codx-junior/workspaces/codx-junior-workspace-silkies/Dockerfile

ARG GROUP_ID=1001

    python3 \
    wget \
    sudo \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN groupadd --gid ${GROUP_ID} codx-junior || true \
    && useradd --uid ${USER_ID} --gid ${GROUP_ID} --create-home --shell /bin/bash codx-junior \
    && echo "codx-junior ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" >> /etc/sudoers \
    && mkdir -p /home/codx-junior-projects/codx-junior \
    && chown -R ${USER_ID}:${GROUP_ID} /home/codx-junior-projects

# 3. Overwrite /usr/bin/systemctl with the replacement script
RUN wget https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gdraheim/docker-systemctl-replacement/master/files/docker/systemctl3.py -O /usr/bin/systemctl \
```
